# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Blade of Shadows is an active personal project, so security fixes are only guaranteed for the latest version on the default branch.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open public issues for suspected security problems.

Instead, report them privately to:

- `info@dhunanyan.com`

Include:

- a short description of the issue,
- steps to reproduce it,
- affected platform or environment,
- any proof-of-concept details that help verify the report.

I will acknowledge the report as soon as possible and work on a fix before public disclosure.
